module.purpose: Defines the abstract two-dimensional geometry contract and a matrix-backed wrapper used by editor shapes for hit testing, measurements, intersections, bounds, and SVG-related operations.
module.summary: This module provides shared geometry behavior for filled and open shapes. The abstract base stores geometry metadata, lazily caches vertices, bounds, area, and length, and implements spatial queries such as point and segment hit testing, distance calculations, interpolation, polygon overlap, and intersections. A transformed wrapper delegates these operations in inverse coordinates and maps results back through a matrix while enforcing uniform scaling.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive vector editing, selection, snapping, and shape layout in the editor. Failures can produce incorrect hit targets, bounds, measurements, intersections, or transformed rendering behavior.
